statement: Let $\triangle ABC$ be acute with $AC > AB$ and $D$ the foot of the $A$-angle bisector on $BC$. Reflections of lines $AB, AC$ in $BC$ meet $AC, AB$ at $E, F$ respectively. A line through $D$ meets $AC$ at $G$ and $AB$ at $H$ (with $G$ strictly between $A, C$ and $H$ strictly between $B, F$). Prove the circumcircles of $\triangle EDG$ and $\triangle FDH$ are tangent.

Let $n \geq k \geq 3$ be integers. For every integer sequence $1 \leq a_1 < \cdots < a_k \leq n$, show one can choose nonneg­ative integers $b_1, \ldots, b_k$ with $0 \leq b_i \leq n$, positive $b_i$ distinct, such that $a_i + b_i$ ($1 \leq i \leq k$) form a permutation of the first $k$ terms of a nonconstant arithmetic progression.
Let $a, b$ be distinct positive integers with $(3a+2) \mid (3b+2)$. Prove $a > b^2$.
Find all $f : \mathbb{R}^+ \to \mathbb{R}^+$ and polynomials $P(x)$ with nonneg­ative real coefficients and $P(0)=0$ satisfying $f(f(x) + P(y)) = f(x-y) + 2y$ for all $x > y > 0$.
